description: Workflows Renovate config — extends the stranske fleet-shared preset (renovate-presets/fleet.json), the single source of truth for grouping, automerge-on-green, dev-tool exclusions, the vendored-minimatch cascade, and the pip-compile manager that regenerates requirements.lock (a `uv pip compile` output) in-PR. The pip-compile manager (provided by the preset since #2406) also enables lockFileMaintenance by default (branchTopic `pip-compile-refresh`), recompiling the lock from scratch on a schedule — this OWNS the periodic refresh and replaced the retired maint-51-dependency-refresh.yml, so do NOT reintroduce a scheduled `uv pip compile --upgrade` workflow. (`--upgrade` is a one-time action flag uv omits from the lock header, and Renovate's pip-compile parser would throw `Option --upgrade not supported (yet)` if it ever appeared there; Renovate scopes its own per-dep bumps with `--upgrade-package`.) Workflows dogfoods the same preset every consumer repo extends; the ONLY Workflows-specific override is below — requirements.txt is a pip-compile SOURCE for requirements.lock here (unlike consumers, whose locks source pyproject.toml only), so pip_requirements is disabled for it to avoid double-managing a lock source (Renovate docs); tools/requirements-llm.txt stays on pip_requirements (standalone LLM pins, not a lock source). This override is intentionally NOT in the fleet preset.

packageRules.description: requirements.txt is a pip-compile source for requirements.lock; let the pip-compile manager own it to avoid duplicate PRs. Workflows-specific — consumer locks source pyproject.toml only, so this disable is NOT in the fleet preset.
Keep Python on the reviewed 3.14 runtime until a coordinated shared-policy migration.

Hosted Gemini CLI gets its own PR so a CLI regression is attributable to one bump. Every release is a 0.x bump; dependencyDashboardApproval false makes sure even a release Renovate grades as major opens a PR instead of waiting on the dashboard (a parked bump would stop the weekly update with nothing reporting it). Minor/patch automerge on green via the fleet rule; the preset's 3-day minimumReleaseAge applies.

customManagers.description: Hosted Gemini CLI pin: reusable-gemini-run.yml writes the version twice (the gemini_cli_version input default and the GEMINI_CLI_VERSION env fallback); both match, so one PR moves both. Owner 2026-11-09: keep the CLI current as releases arrive.
